extra.englishDescription: (figurative) A small extra profit obtained while doing something.
The remaining or unused portion of something.

extra.definitionKo: 영화, 연극, 드라마 등에서 비중이 크지 않은 역. 또는 그 역을 맡은 사람.
extra.englishDescription: A minor role in a film, play, drama, etc.; or a person who plays such a role.

extra.definitionKo: 특별한 사건이 있을 때 임시로 내는 신문이나 잡지.
extra.englishDescription: An edition of newspaper or magazine published temporarily when a special event takes place.

eyesore.englishDescription: A particularly strange or unpleasant thing.

faithfulness.englishDescription: A sincere, genuine attitude or behavior.
The state of being trustworthy and faithful.
The state of being loyal, honest, and sincere.

fearful.definitionKo: 몹시 피하고 싶을 만큼 겁이 나고 무섭다.
fearful.englishDescription: So afraid and frightened as to feel like avoiding something or someone.
Making a person frightened or afraid.

fearful.definitionKo: 어떤 대상이 꺼려지거나 무슨 일이 일어날까 두렵다.
fearful.englishDescription: Feeling scared of something, or feeling afraid something might happen.

fellowship.definitionKo: 친구나 형제 또는 두 집단 사이의 친밀한 감정과 의리.
fellowship.englishDescription: Intimacy and fidelity between friends, siblings, or two groups.

fellowship.definitionKo: 형제 또는 친구 사이의 정과 사랑.
fellowship.englishDescription: Affection and love between brothers or friends.

fellowship.definitionKo: 서로 가깝게 이어지거나 결합되어 통하는 느낌.
fellowship.englishDescription: The feeling of being closely connected or combined and being understood well.

feminine.englishDescription: Having the quality of a woman.

finger-pointing.definitionKo: 상대를 향해 주먹이나 손가락을 힘차게 뻗음.
finger-pointing.englishDescription: An act of stretching out a finger or fist at the other party.
The act of indicating something with a finger.

firmness.englishDescription: The characteristics of a strong and solid object.
A state of being unshakably confident and firm.

flux.englishDescription: The state of keeping moving or changing.

foreplay.definitionKo: 남녀가 육체적 관계를 맺기 전에 서로를 어루만지는 일.
foreplay.englishDescription: The act of a man and a woman caressing each other before engaging in sexual intercourse.

formality.definitionKo: 사회적 모임 등에서 수준이나 분위기에 맞는 일정한 방식.
formality.englishDescription: A predetermined method that is fitting for the level or atmosphere of a certain social gathering.

formality.definitionKo: 반드시 따라야 하는 일정한 규정이나 방식.
formality.englishDescription: A certain rule or way that one is supposed to follow.

formality.definitionKo: 행사를 치르는 일정한 형식과 절차. 또는 정해진 형식과 절차에 따라 치르는 행사.
formality.englishDescription: A certain manner and procedure for carrying out an event; an event carried out according to a certain manner and procedure.

formality.definitionKo: 겉으로 나타나 보이는 모양을 위주로 하는 것.
formality.englishDescription: A state of focusing on the form revealed outwardly.

france.definitionKo: 서유럽에 있는 나라. 유럽에서 손꼽히는 농업 생산국이며 관광 산업이 발달하였다. 주요 언어는 프랑스어이고 수도는 파리이다.
france.englishDescription: A country in western Europe; it is a major producer of agricultural products in Europe and its tourism industry is well developed; its major language is French; its capital is Paris.

france.definitionKo: 서유럽에 있는 나라. ‘프랑스’를 한국식 한자음으로 읽은 이름이다.
france.englishDescription: A country in Western Europe; the name is derived by reading 'France' in Sino-Korean characters.

frankness.definitionKo: 마음에 품은 생각을 숨김없이 말할 수 있을 만큼 아무 거리낌이 없고 솔직함.
frankness.englishDescription: A state of being honest without hesitation to the extent of disclosing all of one's thoughts openly.

funds.englishDescription: A source which necessary money comes from.

fuse.definitionKo: 폭약이 터지게 하기 위해 불을 붙이는 심지.
fuse.englishDescription: A wick lit to explode a bomb.

fuse.definitionKo: 다른 종류의 것이 녹아서 서로 구별이 없게 하나로 합해지다. 또는 다른 종류의 것을 녹여서 서로 구별이 없게 하나로 합하다.
fuse.englishDescription: For things of different kinds to melt and become one, whose separation is impossible, or to melt them to make them become one.

galbi.definitionKo: 음식의 재료로 쓰이는 소, 돼지, 닭 등의 가슴뼈와 거기에 붙은 살. 또는 그것으로 만든 음식.
galbi.englishDescription: Short ribs of cows, pigs, chickens, etc., and the flesh attached to these bones, used as an ingredient for food; or food made from these bones and their flesh.

gallery.definitionKo: 갱 안에서 광석을 나르거나 사람이 드나들도록 만들어 놓은 길.
gallery.englishDescription: A path in a pit to transport mined minerals and for people to come and go.

gallery.definitionKo: 그림이나 미술품 등을 전시하고 파는 곳.
gallery.englishDescription: A place that specializes in exhibiting and selling paintings or other works of art.

gatda.definitionKo: 앞말이 뜻하는 행동의 결과나 상태가 유지됨을 나타내는 말.
gatda.englishDescription: An auxiliary verb used to indicate the continuation of a result or a state of action in the preceding statement.

gatda.definitionKo: 앞말이 뜻하는 행동이나 상태가 뒤의 말의 원인이나 수단, 이유임을 나타내는 말.
gatda.englishDescription: An auxiliary verb used when the action or state of the preceding statement is a cause, reason, or means of the following statement.

geuraeseo.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '그리하여서' (a conjugated form of '그리하다' (do so)).
An abbreviated word for '그러하여서' (a conjugated form of '그러하다' (be so)).

giddy.definitionKo: 주위의 모든 사물이 돌고 있는 듯한 느낌이 들어 몸을 바로잡을 수가 없다.
giddy.englishDescription: Unable to balance oneself because it feels as if the world is revolving around oneself.

giddy.definitionKo: 놀라거나 해서 갑자기 정신이 흐려지고 어지럽다.
giddy.englishDescription: Feeling faint and light-headed suddenly in surprise.
Feeling dizzy and wobbly in one's mind.

glutinous.definitionKo: 잘 끊어지지 않을 정도로 눅눅하고 끈기가 있다.
glutinous.englishDescription: Damp and sticky enough not to fall apart.

glutinous.definitionKo: 반죽이나 밥, 떡 등이 끈기가 많다.
glutinous.englishDescription: A dough, rice, tteok, rice cake, etc., is sticky.

glutinous.definitionKo: 잘 끊어지지 않을 정도로 눅눅하고 끈기가 많다.
glutinous.englishDescription: Damp and sticky enough not to fall apart.

glutinous.definitionKo: 잘 끊어지지 않을 정도로 눅눅하고 끈기가 있다.
glutinous.englishDescription: Humid and sticky enough not to break apart.

glutinous.definitionKo: 잘 끊어지지 않을 정도로 눅눅하고 끈기가 많다.
glutinous.englishDescription: Damp and sticky enough not to fall apart.

gomu.definitionKo: 북을 치며 춤을 추는 한국의 전통 무용.
gomu.englishDescription: A traditional Korean dance, using buks, drums.

gore.definitionKo: 머리를 가까이 가져다 대고 세게 부딪치다.
gore.englishDescription: To thrust one's head close to something and hit it hard.
To hit someone or something hard with a head, horn, etc.

grieve.englishDescription: To experience psychological pain due to sorrow, worry, etc.
To express one's heartache and grief, deeply and bitterly.

grill.definitionKo: (속된 말로) 다른 사람을 괴롭히거나 못살게 굴다.
grill.englishDescription: (slang) To bully or harass a person or animal.
To cook food over a fire.

grill.definitionKo: 불 위에 올려놓고 고기 등을 굽는 판.
grill.englishDescription: A plate that one places over a fire to barbecue meat, etc. on it.

grill.definitionKo: 견디지 못하도록 남을 매우 급하게 몰아치다.
grill.englishDescription: To put someone under unbearable and relentless pressure.

grill.definitionKo: 쇠를 네모지거나 둥근 모양으로 그물처럼 엮어서 만든, 고기나 생선 등을 굽는 기구.
grill.englishDescription: Equipment for cooking meat, fish, etc., made by weaving iron like a net in a square or circular shape.
To persistently ask questions in detail.
To persistently ask questions in detail.

gristmill.definitionKo: 곡식이나 약재 등을 빻아 가루로 만드는 곳.
gristmill.englishDescription: A facility that grinds grains, medicinal herbs, etc., into flour.

guarding.definitionKo: 운동 경기에서 상대방이 공격을 못하도록 가까이에서 막아 냄.
guarding.englishDescription: The act of keeping one's opponent from attacking or scoring.

guarding.definitionKo: 도난이나 침략 등의 사고가 일어나지 않도록 살피고 지키는 일.
guarding.englishDescription: The act of keeping an eye on a building or area in order to prevent theft, break-ins and other such crimes.
The act of defending and protecting.

gugakgi.englishDescription: An instrument for playing gugak, traditional Korean music.

guna.definitionKo: 불교에서, 후세에 복이 되어 돌아오는 좋은 일을 행한 덕.
guna.englishDescription: Virtue accumulated by good deeds in Buddhism, which will return as good fortune in the afterlife.

h.definitionKo: 한글 자모의 열넷째 글자. 이름은 ‘히읗’으로, 이 글자의 소리는 목청에서 나므로 목구멍을 본떠서 만든 ‘ㅇ’의 경우와 같지만 ‘ㅇ’보다 더 세게 나므로 ‘ㅇ’에 획을 더해서 만든 글자이다.
h.englishDescription: The 14th consonant of the Korean alphabet pronounced hieut, which is made by adding a stroke to 'ㅇ', as its sound comes from one's vocal cords like 'ㅇ,' which is created by imitating the shape of a throat, but pronounced more strongly than 'ㅇ.'

hae.definitionKo: 지구가 태양을 한 바퀴 도는 동안을 세는 단위.
hae.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit for counting the number of the earth's revolutions around the sun.

hante.definitionKo: 어떤 물건의 소속이나 위치를 나타내는 조사.
hante.englishDescription: A postpositional particle referring to the ownership or location of an object.

hante.definitionKo: 어떤 행동이 미치는 대상임을 나타내는 조사.
hante.englishDescription: A postpositional particle referring to the subject that an act has an influence on.

hante.definitionKo: 어떤 행동의 주체이거나 비롯되는 대상임을 나타내는 조사.
hante.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to refer to the entity is the subject of an act, or source or cause of such an act.

headset.definitionKo: 밴드로 머리에 걸 수 있게 만든, 라디오 방송이나 음악 등을 듣는 데 쓰는 소형 스피커.
headset.englishDescription: A small speaker designed to be worn over the head in the form of a headband, used for listening to radio broadcasts or music, etc.

heartache.englishDescription: The state of suffering and hurting deep in one's heart.

heartache.definitionKo: 다른 사람이 알지 못하게 속으로 걱정하거나 괴로워하는 일.
heartache.englishDescription: A state of worrying or suffering in a secretive manner that other people do  not realize is being experienced.

hit-and-run.englishDescription: An act of running away hastily.

hollow.englishDescription: Being empty inside; an object that is empty.

hollow.definitionKo: 땅을 깊고 길게 파서 굴과 같이 만든 큰 구덩이.
hollow.englishDescription: A long, deep hole made like a tunnel by digging in the ground.

hollow.definitionKo: 가운데가 둥글게 푹 파이거나 들어간 데가 있다.
hollow.englishDescription: Being dented or curved inwards in the middle.

hollow.definitionKo: 가운데가 둥글게 푹 패어 있거나 들어가 있는 상태이다.
hollow.englishDescription: Hollowed out or curving inwards in the middle.

hollow.definitionKo: 가운데가 둥글게 푹 파이거나 들어간 데가 있다.
hollow.englishDescription: Hollowed out or curving inwards in the middle.

hollow.definitionKo: 눈이 움푹 패어 기운 없어 보이다.
hollow.englishDescription: Looking weak or burned out because one has hollow eyes.

hollow.definitionKo: 속이 비어서 안으로 오목하게 들어가 있다.
hollow.englishDescription: An object being empty, bending inward.

hollow.definitionKo: 땅바닥이 움푹 패어 빠지기 쉬운 구덩이.
hollow.englishDescription: A hollow, sunken hole in the ground, easy to fall into.

hollow.definitionKo: 눈이 쑥 들어가 있고 생기가 없다.

honesty.englishDescription: (figurative) A quality of being very honest and upright.
The state of being trustworthy and faithful.

honesty.definitionKo: 마음에 거짓이나 꾸밈이 없고 바르고 곧음.
honesty.englishDescription: The quality of being righteous and straightforward without deceptiveness or airs.

honesty.definitionKo: 마음에 거짓이나 꾸밈이 없고 바르고 곧은 성질.
honesty.englishDescription: The quality of being righteous and straightforward without deceptiveness or airs.
A person's sincere, genuine quality or character.

hooligan.definitionKo: 돌아다니며 남의 재물을 빼앗는 사람들의 무리.
hooligan.englishDescription: A band of people going around and taking away others' property.

hooligan.definitionKo: 남을 자주 괴롭히며 나쁜 짓을 하고도 부끄러워할 줄 모르는 사람들의 무리.
hooligan.englishDescription: A band of people not ashamed of what they do even if they frequently harass others and do evil things.

hooligan.definitionKo: 필요에 따라 쉽게 폭력을 휘둘러 남에게 해를 입히는 사람이나 무리.
hooligan.englishDescription: A person or a group of people harming others, by easily using violence, as needed.

hours.definitionKo: 어떤 일이 시작되어 끝날 때까지의 동안.
hours.englishDescription: An interval from the time something starts to the time it ends.

hugoguryeo.definitionKo: 한반도에 있던 나라. 궁예가 901년에 송도를 수도로 하여 세웠으며 후백제, 신라와 함께 후삼국을 이루었다가 918년에 고려에 멸망하였다.
hugoguryeo.englishDescription: later Goguryeo: An ancient country on the Korean Peninsula, established in 901 by Gung Ye with its capital at Songdo; it formed the Later Three Kingdoms along with the Hubaekje, Later Baekje, and Silla Kingdom and  was subsequently brought down by the Goryeo Dynasty in 918.

husking.definitionKo: 벼, 보리 등의 낟알에서 껍질을 벗겨 내는 일.
husking.englishDescription: An act of peeling the grains of rice, barley, etc.

idol.definitionKo: '우상'이라는 뜻으로, 젊은이들에게 인기 있는 젊은 연예인.
idol.englishDescription: Meaning ‘idol’, a young celebrity popular among young people.

idol.definitionKo: 신과 같이 여겨 우러러 받드는 물건이나 사람.
idol.englishDescription: An object or person who is worshipped as a being like a god.

idol.definitionKo: 기독교에서, 하나님이 아닌 신의 모양을 만들어 놓은 것.
idol.englishDescription: In Christianity, something that has the shape of a god and is worshipped even though it is not God.

idolization.definitionKo: 우러러 받드는 대상이 됨. 또는 그러한 대상으로 만듦.
idolization.englishDescription: The state of having become an object that is worshipped; the act of making something or someone an object that is worshipped.

illuminate.definitionKo: 빛을 내는 것이 다른 것을 밝게 하거나 나타나게 하다.
illuminate.englishDescription: For something that emits light, to make another thing  appear or be illuminated by light.

imports.englishDescription: Goods that are purchased from foreign countries.

in-transit.englishDescription: The middle stage of going to a certain place.

indigestion.definitionKo: 음식을 먹은 후 소화가 안 되는 증상.
indigestion.englishDescription: A phenomenon of food not being digested after one eats.

indigestion.definitionKo: 한의학에서, 먹은 것이 잘 소화되지 않는 증상.
indigestion.englishDescription: In Oriental medicine, the symptom of having difficulties digesting food.

infection.definitionKo: 나쁜 버릇, 풍습, 가치관, 환경 등이 영향을 주어 똑같이 하게 함.
infection.englishDescription: A bad habit, custom, values, environment, etc., affecting someone adversely to make him/her equally bad, impure, or immoral.

infection.definitionKo: 병균이 사람이나 동식물의 몸 안으로 들어가 퍼짐.
infection.englishDescription: A germ's invading and spreading throughout the body of a plant or animal.

infection.definitionKo: 컴퓨터 바이러스가 컴퓨터의 하드 디스크나 파일에 들어가 고장을 일으킴.
infection.englishDescription: A virus's infiltrating the hard disk or file of a computer, causing it to malfunction.
The act of one's disease being spread to another.

instructions.definitionKo: 일이나 사물의 내용, 이유, 사용법 등을 설명한 글.
instructions.englishDescription: An explanatory writing that describes the content, reasons, directions, etc., of a task or object.

intertwine.englishDescription: To make several things mixed or entwined complicatedly.
For several things to be mixed or entwined complicatedly.

inundation.englishDescription: An overflowing of a river, stream, etc.

inundation.definitionKo: 바람직하지 못한 세력이나 물건 등이 마구 생겨 나와 널리 퍼짐.
inundation.englishDescription: A state in which an undesirable power, goods, etc., forms and prevails.

inundation.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 비가 많이 오거나 물이 새서 바닥 등에 물이 많이 괴인 것.
inundation.englishDescription: (figurative) The state of the floor, etc., being flooded due to a heavy rain or water leakage.
The state of being submerged in water.

ireogo.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '이리하고' (a conjugated form of '이리하다' (do in this way)).

ireomyeonseo.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '이리하면서' (a conjugated form of '이리하다' (do in this way)).

ireona.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '이리하나' (a conjugated form of '이리하다' (do in this way)).
An abbreviated word for '이러하나' (a conjugated form of '이러하다' (be like this)).

jesappap.definitionKo: 제사를 지내기 위해 차려 놓은 밥.
jesappap.englishDescription: offerings: Steamed rice prepared for an ancestral rite.
offerings: Steamed rice that remains after an ancestral rite.

karma.definitionKo: 불교에서, 미래의 좋고 나쁨을 결정한다고 하는 현재의 행동.
karma.englishDescription: In Buddhism, one's current actions that are believed to affect one's fortune in the future.

karma.definitionKo: 이전에 행한 선악에 따라 현재의 행복이나 불행이 결정되는 것.
karma.englishDescription: A casual relationship in which a person's current happiness or misfortune is determined by his/her previous good or bad deeds.

layperson.definitionKo: 특정한 신분이나 지위, 특징을 지니지 않은 보통 사람.
layperson.englishDescription: A common person who has no specific status, position, or characters.

layperson.definitionKo: 교회에서 직책을 가지지 않은 일반 신자.
layperson.englishDescription: In church, an ordinary believer without a title.

lecherous.englishDescription: One's behavior being loose and not decent.

legation.definitionKo: 외교관이 해외에 파견되어 사무를 보는 곳.
legation.englishDescription: A place abroad where a diplomat is dispatched and works.

licentious.englishDescription: Acting carelessly at one's will without reserve.

literary.definitionKo: 문학의 특성을 가진. 또는 문학과 관련된.
literary.englishDescription: Having the character of literature; being related to literature.

mah-jong.definitionKo: 네 사람이 글씨나 숫자가 새겨진 136개의 패를 가지고 짝을 맞추어 승부를 겨루는 놀이.
mah-jong.englishDescription: A game played by four people in which players match 136 tiles with characters or numbers engraved on them.

major.definitionKo: 학교나 병원 등에서 학과나 전문 연구 분야를 구분하는 단위.
major.englishDescription: In a school or hospital, the unit that divides academic departments or fields of professional research.

major.definitionKo: 어떤 분야를 전문적으로 연구하거나 공부하는 사람.
major.englishDescription: A person who studies or researches a certain field professionally.
